description: This PHP class provides integration with Google Calendar API within the SuiteCRM project. It manages OAuth authentication, retrieves, creates, updates, and deletes calendar events, and handles connection testing and calendar management specific to SuiteCRM's Google Calendar synchronization.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarProvider
classes.description: A class that manages Google Calendar integration, including OAuth authentication, event synchronization, and calendar management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to Google Calendar, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: testGoogleCalendarConnection
methods.description: Performs an actual connection test to Google Calendar API, verifying credentials and calendar access.

methods.name: initializeGoogleServices
methods.description: Initializes Google Client and Calendar Service if not already initialized.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves a valid OAuth access token, attempting refresh if needed.

methods.name: getOAuthConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth connection associated with a given calendar account.

methods.name: getOrCreateSuiteCRMCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the existing SuiteCRM calendar or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events from Google Calendar based on a query.

methods.name: convertFromGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a Google Calendar event object into an internal CalendarAccountEvent object.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a single event by its ID from Google Calendar.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Google Calendar.

methods.name: convertToGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into a Google Calendar event object.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in Google Calendar.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar by its ID.
